notes: Compatibility is determined by protocol and ABI versions, not by accepting every pre-1.0 release.
Launch requires a signed policy, launch grant, and whole-build manifest from Certael Core.
Production installs use isolated signed multi-game registrations; legacy explicit launch remains development-only.
Protocol v1 health heartbeats and signed revocation frames are supported.
The Agent is optional user-mode evidence and does not make an untrusted client authoritative.
